info.title: Moogsoft
info.description: Authentication: HTTP Basic. Moogsoft Enterprise / APEX AIOps event correlation and Situation management: alert lifecycle, Situation lifecycle, teams, users, and integration status/configuration via the Graze API and the Integrations API.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 38 of 165 upstream operations covering common CRUD for automation: alert lifecycle (list/get/assign/close/resolve/severity/acknowledge/custom info), Situation lifecycle (create/list/get/assign/close/resolve/description/custom info/alert membership), team CRUD, user CRUD, and integration status/configuration. Skips deep correlation-rule and ML-model administration (Cookbooks, Recipes, Tempus, Merge Groups, Entropy), workflow-engine authoring, security realm configuration, licensing, and reporting/statistics endpoints. See the repo README for the full scope and the full spec.
